facts.text: Garqi was an agriworld and the sector capital of the Tadrin sector, in the Outer Rim Territories.

evidence.quote: Garqi was an agriworld and the sector capital of the Tadrin sector, in the Outer Rim Territories.

facts.text: Natural elements in Garqi's crust gave the native plant life a purple coloration.

evidence.quote: Natural elements in Garqi's crust gave the native plant life a purple coloration.

facts.text: From space, the planet appeared a beautiful, hypnotic violet color.

evidence.quote: From space, the planet appeared a beautiful, hypnotic violet color.

facts.text: Garqi was aligned by the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.

evidence.quote: Garqi was aligned by the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.

facts.text: During the Outer Rim Sieges in the late stages of the war, the Confederacy of Independent Systems battled Republic forces on Garqi.

evidence.quote: During the Outer Rim Sieges in the late stages of the war, the Confederacy of Independent Systems battled Republic forces on Garqi.

facts.text: In response, the Galactic Republic sent an army under the Jedi General Traavis.

evidence.quote: In response, the Galactic Republic sent an army under the Jedi General Traavis.

facts.text: During the battle, Republic artillery accidentally bombed a Garqian farmhouse and General Traavis deployed clone commandos to search for survivors and to bring them to a refugee camp.

evidence.quote: During the battle, Republic artillery accidentally bombed a Garqian farmhouse and General Traavis deployed clone commandos to search for survivors and to bring them to a refugee camp.

facts.text: Aiwha Squad notably escorted the young child Evan to the Republic encampment on the planet.

evidence.quote: Aiwha Squad notably escorted the young child Evan to the Republic encampment on the planet.

facts.text: Near the end of the Clone Wars, the Republic finally defeated the Separatists on Garqi.

evidence.quote: Near the end of the Clone Wars, the Republic finally defeated the Separatists on Garqi.

facts.text: General Traavis was lost during the conflict when Aiwha Squad murdered him due to the execution of Order 66.

evidence.quote: General Traavis was lost during the conflict when Aiwha Squad murdered him due to the execution of Order 66.

facts.text: Prior to the Battle of Endor in 4 ABY, the Galactic Empire established a military garrison on the planet.

evidence.quote: Prior to the Battle of Endor in 4 ABY, the Galactic Empire established a military garrison on the planet.

facts.text: Despite the destruction of the second Death Star, the Empire still held on to Garqi, keeping its inhabitants in check through the Garqi Eagle Squadron.

evidence.quote: Despite the destruction of the second Death Star, the Empire still held on to Garqi, keeping its inhabitants in check through the Garqi Eagle Squadron.

facts.text: However, the population continued to resist the Empire, with much of the movement originating from the Garqi Agricultural University, located near the planetary capital of Pesktda.

evidence.quote: However, the population continued to resist the Empire, with much of the movement originating from the Garqi Agricultural University, located near the planetary capital of Pesktda.

facts.text: After Corran Horn left the Corellian Security Force, he came to Garqi on the run from the Empire.

evidence.quote: After Corran Horn left the Corellian Security Force, he came to Garqi on the run from the Empire.

facts.text: Working undercover as an aide to Imperial Prefect Mosh Barris, Corran helped many political prisoners escape from Garqi.

evidence.quote: Working undercover as an aide to Imperial Prefect Mosh Barris, Corran helped many political prisoners escape from Garqi.

facts.text: In the following years, the Garqi system was part of the Pentastar Alignment and later fell under control of the Imperial Remnant.

evidence.quote: In the following years, the Garqi system was part of the Pentastar Alignment and later fell under control of the Imperial Remnant.

facts.text: After the Empire was driven from Garqi, the planet joined the New Republic.

evidence.quote: After the Empire was driven from Garqi, the planet joined the New Republic.

facts.text: The New Republic was forced to abandon the population, who went underground, resisting the alien invaders.

evidence.quote: The New Republic was forced to abandon the population, who went underground, resisting the alien invaders.

facts.text: A Jedi-led force scouted the planet in a battle in 25 ABY and succeeded in divining a terrible flaw in Yuuzhan Vong crab-shell armor as it came into contact with Ithorian bafforr tree pollen from the botanical gardens in Pesktda.

evidence.quote: A Jedi-led force scouted the planet in a battle in 25 ABY and succeeded in divining a terrible flaw in Yuuzhan Vong crab-shell armor as it came into contact with Ithorian bafforr tree pollen from the botanical gardens in Pesktda.

facts.text: Garqi would remain under the control of the Yuuzhan Vong for the remainder of the war, until the galaxy was liberated in 29 ABY.

evidence.quote: Garqi would remain under the control of the Yuuzhan Vong for the remainder of the war, until the galaxy was liberated in 29 ABY.

facts.text: After this time, the region was absorbed into the Imperial Remnant, deep in its space during the Second Galactic Civil War and, by 137 ABY, remaining in the possession of the Fel Empire and subsequent Empire-in-exile.

evidence.quote: After this time, the region was absorbed into the Imperial Remnant, deep in its space during the Second Galactic Civil War and, by 137 ABY, remaining in the possession of the Fel Empire and subsequent Empire-in-exile.

facts.text: Pesktda was the capital city of Garqi, a graceful city of broad avenues lined with bimiza trees and dotted with open-air plazas. It was the only consolidated population center on the planet and contained one-quarter of the world population.

evidence.quote: Pesktda was the capital city of Garqi, a graceful city of broad avenues lined with bimiza trees and dotted with open-air plazas. It was the only consolidated population center on the planet and contained one-quarter of the world population.

facts.text: Garqi Agricultural University, also known as Garqi Ag University or Garqi Ag, was the leading university on Garqi. It was located in the capital city of Pesktda, and was a center of anti-Imperial sentiment during the Galactic Civil War.

evidence.quote: Garqi Agricultural University, also known as Garqi Ag University or Garqi Ag, was the leading university on Garqi. It was located in the capital city of Pesktda, and was a center of anti-Imperial sentiment during the Galactic Civil War.

facts.text: The Vlassy River was a major river on Garqi, running through the Vlassy Nature Preserve. Surrounded by forested bluffs and canyons, it was deemed unsuitable for farming, and had since become a major tourist destination.

evidence.quote: The Vlassy River was a major river on Garqi, running through the Vlassy Nature Preserve. Surrounded by forested bluffs and canyons, it was deemed unsuitable for farming, and had since become a major tourist destination.

facts.text: The Vlassy Nature Preserve was a secluded wildlife preserve, located along the Vlassy River on Garqi. Located eight hundred kilometers southeast of Pesktda, the Preserve was a popular destination for Garqians and off-world tourists alike.

evidence.quote: The Vlassy Nature Preserve was a secluded wildlife preserve, located along the Vlassy River on Garqi. Located eight hundred kilometers southeast of Pesktda, the Preserve was a popular destination for Garqians and off-world tourists alike.

facts.text: The Pesktda Xenobotanical Garden was a garden located in the city of Pesktda on the planet Garqi. A set of bafforr trees was located at the gardens.

facts.text: Garqi Agricultural Combine was an organization that supplied the planet Garqi with foodstuffs. Essara Till worked there.
